individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot of n=141 samples represented as individual measurements, each marker is an individual data point.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on the scatter plot or marginal histograms.

individual-data-points.explanation: Each marker represents the mean of 6 samples per reporter with error bars (SD); the underlying individual replicate values are not overlaid.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Data represents the mean +/- s.d. of 6 samples per reporter (n = 2 biological replicates a technical triplicates or duplicates [HCC1806 Per2-Luc, n = 5]). n = 3 for MCF10A and MDAMB468-Per2-Luc (single experiment).
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars (mean +/- SD) are clearly defined in the caption.

individual-data-points.explanation: Smoothed density/line curves of distributions; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are displayed on these distribution curves.

individual-data-points.explanation: Box plots are overlaid with individual sample data points (dots for Per2-Luc and Bmal1-Luc).

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: with the bottom and top edges of the boxes representing the 25th and 75th percentiles, respectively. Extending whiskers represent data points within 1.5 times the interquartile range from lower and upper quartile. Median values are marked by red horizontal lines, and outliers by red crosses.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Box, whisker, median, and outlier elements are all explicitly defined in the caption.

individual-data-points.explanation: Polar histograms display frequency distributions, not means requiring overlaid individual points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are present on these polar histograms.

individual-data-points.explanation: Single representative example trace (line plot) fitted with a decaying sinusoidal model; not an averaged/aggregated plot requiring overlaid points.

error-bars-defined.explanation: No error bars are shown; this is an illustrative single-example fit.

individual-data-points.explanation: Scatter plot of n=117 individual samples, each marker representing one sample's fitted parameters.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Error bars represent the standard deviation of the fitted parameters, reflecting their uncertainty as determined by the fitting process.
error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are clearly defined in the caption as representing fit parameter uncertainty (SD).
